title: My 3 a.m. ride had one passenger. The mirror showed two.
style_prompt: cinematic horror film still, dark, moody, low key lighting, 35mm film grain, desaturated, realistic, suburban American house at night, no text, no watermark
hook_text: My 3 a.m. ride had one passenger. The mirror showed two.

scenes.narration: At 3 a.m., I picked up one passenger. A quiet guy in a gray hoodie. He didn't say a word. Just got in the back.

shots.prompt: inside a car at night, view from the driver seat through the windshield, empty wet suburban road lit by headlights, dashboard glow

scenes.narration: Problem is, my rearview mirror showed two people in the back seat.

shots.prompt: close up of a car rearview mirror at night, the reflection shows the backs of two dark hooded heads in the back seat, no faces visible, cold blue light

scenes.narration: I turned around. Just him. Earbuds in. Staring at his phone. The seat next to him was empty.

shots.prompt: dark back seat of a car at night seen from the front, one hooded figure from behind with the hood up covering the head, phone glow, empty seat beside, no face

scenes.narration: I looked back at the mirror. The second one was still there. Sitting right behind me. Perfectly still. Watching me drive.

shots.prompt: car rearview mirror at night reflecting a dark back seat with a vague black shadow shape behind the driver seat, no person details, no face, horror

scenes.narration: Then my phone buzzed. A message from the app.

shots.prompt: smartphone mounted on a car dashboard at night glowing with a notification, rain on the windshield, dark

scenes.narration: Your passenger has ended the trip. Please check the back seat for belongings.

shots.prompt: smartphone mounted on a car dashboard at night glowing with a notification, rain on the windshield, dark

overlays.text: Please check the back seat for belongings

scenes.narration: Trip ended? We were still on the highway. Doing seventy miles an hour.

shots.prompt: dark empty highway at night seen through a car windshield, street lights passing, eerie fog

scenes.narration: I checked the mirror. The guy in the hoodie was gone. His door was still locked.

shots.prompt: empty back seat of a car at night, door lock pressed down, phone left on the seat glowing, cold light

scenes.narration: But the other one was still back there. I could hear it breathing. And slowly, it leaned forward. Right next to my ear.

shots.prompt: dark car interior at night, a shadowy shape leaning between the front seats toward the driver, no face visible, horror film still

scenes.narration: So tell me. Do you pull over, or keep driving?
